## Notes

David Braben and Ian Bell; Acornsoft, BBC Micro, September 1984; eight procedurally generated galaxies from seeds; 7 light-year hyperspace limit by fuel; trading, piracy, bounty hunting, combat rating to Elite; credited with defining space trading genre; lists influenced titles including EVE Online.
